title: Emission Beaconing: sample-based subtoken timing & cache-impact enrichment
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Add a low-overhead, sample-driven layer of per-subtoken timing beacons and cache-delta tags that let downstream pipelines attribute latency and downstream cost to fine-grained emission events. This ticket implements the end-to-end plan: runtime probe hooks, lightweight beacon payloads on sampled requests, ingestion schema for the metrics/log pipeline, and dashboard panels to validate signal quality and cost impact.

Why this approach: full per-token instrumentation at 100% traffic is prohibitively expensive in storage and throughput. We will use deterministic sampling + sticky sampling for long-lived sessions and reservoir sampling for bursty flows so we capture representative token-level timings while bounding telemetry volume. Each sampled emission carries a compact beacon with: subtoken_index, emission_phase (kv_lookup|kv_miss|compute|postprocess), delta_ms, kv_tag (hit|miss|prefetch), and a small provenance tag linking to the request-level span. The runtime will synthesize a cache_delta field that represents estimated additional compute/IO caused by a miss (in ms) so we can later chargeback cost to tokens that triggered misses.

Data model & payload size: beacons are UTF-8 JSON lines no larger than ~220 bytes encoded (we aim for <= 200 bytes). To minimize cardinality we canonicalize kv_tag values and keep provenance links as short opaque ids. All fields are single-level primitives to avoid nested parsing costs in the pipeline.

Pipeline changes: The ingestion system will be extended to accept a token-beacon stream (new kafka topic: observability.token_beacons.v1). A lightweight Flink job extracts metrics and emits two artifacts: (1) per-request aggregation (per-token mean/percentile times, cache-impact summary) and (2) compact per-token events forwarded to the existing trace-aggregation bucket for forensic queries. Aggregates are stored in the metrics store (prometheus-compatible series and a ClickHouse table) tagged by model, runtime-variant, and route.

Dashboard & alerts: New dashboard: "Token Beacon Health" with panels for sample-rate by route, sample representativeness (sampled tokens / total tokens), kv_miss_ratio_by_model, median token_delta_ms_by_phase, and estimated token-cost-chargeback_rate. Alerts: high-drop-rate (sample acceptance < 60%), and kv_miss_ratio spike (relative increase > 50% over baseline).

Rollout plan: feature-flagged, staged rollout: 1) canary on <1% traffic with aggressive sampling to validate invariants and size estimates; 2) broaden to 10% with default sampling; 3) 100% traffic with sampling sticky for sessions (not all tokens) and dynamic backoff if pipeline lag increases. We will keep a fallback switch to disable emission beaconing per-cluster if downstream pipeline lag exceeds thresholds.

Trade-offs & open questions: We trade off perfect per-token coverage for cost and observability usefulness. Open questions: exact reservoir size for long requests, bucketization scheme for compute delta to reduce cardinality, and whether to join beacons with the per-token tokenization map for lexical-level analysis. Engineering effort focuses on safe, observable rollout and verifying that sampled signals yield stable chargeback estimates within 5% error of a small full-capture baseline test.

acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits beacon payload for sampled requests with expected field set
Beacon payload size on average <= 220 bytes for 95% of samples
Ingestion job processes token_beacons.v1 topic at target throughput without >30s lag at 10% rollout
Aggregate metrics (kv_miss_ratio, median token_delta_ms_by_phase) available in metrics store and visible in dashboard
Chargeback estimate stable within 5% vs full-capture baseline test
Feature flag supports per-cluster disable and traffic percentage control
comments: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting — agreed sampling strategy: deterministic by request-id + reservoir for long sequences. Action: Marco to prototype beacon schema and size estimates.
2026-02-20: Prototype runtime hook landed on feature branch. Initial payload average 184 bytes (json compacted). See PR #1829.
2026-02-25: Telemetry team validated ingestion consumer can sustain 2x expected QPS in perf sandbox. Need to add backpressure counters to monitor topic lag.
2026-03-03: Design review feedback — reduce provenance token from 64 -> 12 chars to lower cardinality, add kv_prefetch tag option. Updated schema in design doc.

2026-03-08: Canary 0.5% started; observed kv_miss_ratio aligns with baseline but sample representativeness metric low for one route (edge-transformer). Follow-up: increase sampling for that route to 5%.
2026-03-12: Pipeline job updated to emit a compact per-request rollup to ClickHouse. Early dashboards show median token_delta_ms_by_phase ~ 1.8ms (compute) + 3.4ms (kv_miss delta).
2026-03-14: Observability: added alert recipe for ingestion lag >45s and sampling acceptance <60%. Preparing to expand to 10% on 2026-03-18 conditioned on no lag regressions.
notes: Keep metric names short and stable. Proposed: rw.token.beacon.kv_miss_ratio, rw.token.beacon.delta_ms.phase, rw.token.beacon.sample_rate
Plan to run a 48-hour full-capture baseline on a small internal model to quantify sampling bias before 100% rollout
Estimate initial storage cost: ~1.2TB/month at 10% sampling for top 5 models; refine after canary
